title: C++ SDK for the Zerobus Ingest connector is now available in Beta
body: A C++ SDK for the Zerobus Ingest connector in Lakeflow Connect is now available in Beta. The SDK provides a high-throughput gRPC client for ingesting records directly into Unity Catalog Delta tables, with support for JSON and Protocol Buffers. See [Use the Zerobus Ingest connector](/aws/en/ingestion/zerobus-ingest).
